 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO cost_center_auto_failures(company_id,source_kind,source_id,last_error)
      VALUES(p_company_id,p_source_kind,p_source_id,left(p_error,1000))

      p_source_id,SQLERRM;
  END;
END
$function$

{"kind":"f","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cost_center_historical_batch_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
     OR NEW.company_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.company_id
     OR NEW.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by
     OR NEW.source_kind IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.source_kind
     OR NEW.request_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.request_snapshot
     OR NEW.source_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.source_snapshot
     OR NEW.source_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.source_hash
     OR NEW.candidate_count IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.candidate_count
     OR NEW.candidate_native_total IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.candidate_native_total
     OR NEW.candidate_usd_total IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.candidate_usd_total
     OR NEW.expires_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.expires_at
     OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
     OR OLD.status <> 'PREVIEW' OR NEW.status <> 'APPLIED'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Historical allocation preview is immutable and may be applied only once'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

{"kind":"f","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cost_center_voucher_in_reversal_pair(p_voucher_id integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM vouchers v
    WHERE v.id = p_voucher_id AND (
      v.reversal_of_voucher_id IS NOT NULL
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vouchers rev
        WHERE rev.reversal_of_voucher_id = v.id AND rev.deleted_at IS NULL)
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounting_posting_requests apr
        WHERE apr.voucher_id = v.id AND apr.source_type = 'voucher-reversal')
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounting_posting_requests apr
        JOIN vouchers rev ON rev.id = apr.voucher_id AND rev.deleted_at IS NULL
        WHERE apr.company_id = v.company_id AND apr.source_type = 'voucher-reversal'
          AND apr.source_id = v.id::text)
    )
  )
$function$

{"kind":"f","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.erp_audit_log_append_only()

AS $function$
   BEGIN

        AND COALESCE(lower(btrim(current_setting('app.audit_log_maintenance', true))), '') = 'retention'

                        OLD.id, OLD.table_name, CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN 'deleted' ELSE 'changed' END);

{"kind":"f","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.erp_default_ledger_opening_side(p_type text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
     SELECT CASE
              WHEN t IN ('asset', 'current asset', 'fixed asset', 'bank', 'cash', 'expense', 'direct expense', 'indirect expense', 'government taxes', 'cogs') THEN 'Dr'
              WHEN t IN ('liability', 'current liability', 'loan', 'loans', 'duty agent', 'transporter agent', 'accounts payable', 'equity', 'profit', 'income', 'revenue', 'indirect income', 'direct income') THEN 'Cr'

{"kind":"f","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.erp_ledger_account_delete_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
   DECLARE
     balance numeric;
   BEGIN
     IF erp_ledger_integrity_bypassed() OR NEW.deleted_at IS NULL OR OLD.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN
       RETURN NEW;
     END IF;
     -- Wave 16 (B): a sideless opening takes the engine's side for the type (it assumed Dr).
     SELECT (CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(OLD.opening_balance_side, ''),
                                erp_default_ledger_opening_side(OLD.account_type)) = 'Cr'
                  THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) * COALESCE(OLD.opening_balance, 0)
            + COALESCE(SUM(ve.debit_amount - ve.credit_amount), 0)
       INTO balance
       FROM voucher_entries ve JOIN vouchers v ON v.id = ve.voucher_id
      WHERE ve.ledger_account_id = OLD.id AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.optional = false;
     IF balance <> 0 THEN
       RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',
         MESSAGE = format('LEDGER_ACCOUNT_HAS_BALANCE: account %s has a balance of %s and cannot be deleted', OLD.id, balance),
         HINT = 'Move its balance to another account with a journal entry first, or deactivate it instead.';
     END IF;
     RETURN NEW;
   END
   $function$
","publicExecute":true,"comment":null}

{"kind":"f","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.erp_ledger_row_audit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
   DECLARE
     v_actor text := erp_audit_current_actor();
     v_name text := COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(current_setting('app.current_actor_name', true)), ''), erp_audit_current_actor());
   BEGIN
     IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
       INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, username, company_id, action, table_name, record_id, record_identifier, changes)
       SELECT v_actor, v_name, (img->>'company_id')::integer, 'row_insert', TG_TABLE_NAME, (img->>'id')::integer,
              COALESCE(img->>'voucher_number', 'voucher:' || (img->>'voucher_id')),
              jsonb_build_object('source', 'db_trigger', 'row', jsonb_build_object('new', img))
         FROM (SELECT to_jsonb(n) AS img FROM audit_new n) AS rows;
     ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
       INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, username, company_id, action, table_name, record_id, record_identifier, changes)
       SELECT v_actor, v_name, (after->>'company_id')::integer, 'row_update', TG_TABLE_NAME, (after->>'id')::integer,
              COALESCE(after->>'voucher_number', 'voucher:' || (after->>'voucher_id')),
              jsonb_build_object('source', 'db_trigger', 'row', jsonb_build_object('old', before, 'new', after))
         FROM (SELECT to_jsonb(o) AS before, to_jsonb(n) AS after
                 FROM audit_old o JOIN audit_new n ON n.id = o.id) AS rows
        WHERE before IS DISTINCT FROM after;
     ELSE
       INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, username, company_id, action, table_name, record_id, record_identifier, changes)
       SELECT v_actor, v_name, (img->>'company_id')::integer, 'row_delete', TG_TABLE_NAME, (img->>'id')::integer,
              COALESCE(img->>'voucher_number', 'voucher:' || (img->>'voucher_id')),
              jsonb_build_object('source', 'db_trigger', 'row', jsonb_build_object('old', img))
         FROM (SELECT to_jsonb(o) AS img FROM audit_old o) AS rows;
     END IF;
     RETURN NULL;
   END
   $function$
","publicExecute":true,"comment":"2026-10-audit-trail-v1"}

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
          BEGIN
            IF NEW.goods_otw_voucher_id IS NULL THEN
              RETURN NEW;
            END IF;

            IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' OR NEW.goods_otw_voucher_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.goods_otw_voucher_id THEN
              -- Linking: fill an empty header supplier only.
              UPDATE vouchers
              SET supplier_id = NEW.supplier_id
              WHERE id = NEW.goods_otw_voucher_id
                AND company_id = NEW.company_id
                AND supplier_id IS NULL
                AND NEW.supplier_id IS NOT NULL;
            ELSIF NEW.supplier_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.supplier_id THEN
              -- Supplier change: only a voucher that is not posted follows it.
              UPDATE vouchers
              SET supplier_id = NEW.supplier_id
              WHERE id = NEW.goods_otw_voucher_id
                AND company_id = NEW.company_id
                AND optional = true
                AND deleted_at IS NULL
                AND supplier_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.supplier_id;

              UPDATE voucher_entries ve
              SET supplier_id = NEW.supplier_id
              FROM ledger_accounts la, vouchers v
              WHERE ve.voucher_id = NEW.goods_otw_voucher_id
                AND v.id = ve.voucher_id
                AND v.company_id = NEW.company_id
                AND v.optional = true
                AND v.deleted_at IS NULL
                AND ve.ledger_account_id = la.id
                AND la.company_id = NEW.company_id
                AND la.sub_type = 'sp_otw_clearing'
                AND ve.supplier_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.supplier_id;
            END IF;
            RETURN NEW;
          END;
          $function$
